text: Ritual is positioned as infrastructure for onchain AI coordination and execution.
Ritual documentation is organized in a developer-focused docs portal by the Ritual Foundation.
Ritual resources are published across ritual.net and ritualfoundation.org domains for ecosystem and technical context.
The bot can retrieve documentation-grounded answers by searching indexed Ritual docs snippets before generating a response.
Ritual technical knowledge for this bot is designed to be refreshed by scheduled re-indexing of official docs sources.
